swap_risks: CAUTION BANDWIDTH & PHASE MARGIN: GBWP differs by 17.1x (LM358DR: 0.7 MHz p.10 vs NE5532DR: 12 MHz p.4); higher-bandwidth replacements can oscillate with capacitive loads or stray feedback capacitance without an isolation resistor.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 16.7x (LM358DR: 0.3 V/µs p.10 vs NE5532DR: 5 V/µs p.4); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).
engineering_verdict: LM358DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) and NE5532DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to GBWP differs >= 3x; slew rate differs >= 3x. Key datasheet deltas: device type is opamp (push-pull) vs opamp (push-pull), supply limit is 30 V (p.5) vs 30 V (p.3), max Vos is 7 mV (p.10) vs 4 mV (p.4), input bias current is 20000 pA (p.10) vs 200000 pA (p.4), and Iq/ch is 350 µA (p.10) vs 3000 µA (p.4). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.2), thermal margin (θJA 124.7 vs 97 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
